formulaBlock.normalization: AQUA (WATER) one entry; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate (2) defining anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3); no reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Only one buffer; olefin sulfonate is a robust cleanser. Convention unchanged.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes, all after Parfum: Butyrospermum Parkii Butter (10), Polyester-37 (11), Glycol Distearate (13), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (15), Polyquaternium-39 (19), with Glycerin (5) and Panthenol (14). C2 not met (no early silicone, butter not prominent).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Every conditioning route is post-fragrance; a cleansing-led low reading is realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: deposition families are present (butter, film former, two cationic polymers) but each sits after Parfum at trace-like level, facing an effective C1 olefin-sulfonate chassis.

depositionLoad.rationale: Shea butter 10, Polyester-37 11, guar 15, Polyquaternium-39 19, all after the fragrance marker.

persistence.rationale: Waxy butter and a film former are more persistent per unit than liquid oils, but at low level.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Light, trace-positioned routes against moderate reset fit the low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: three deposition families are present, but every one is listed after Parfum (each likely well below 1%), there is no silicone and no prominent lipid, and the effective C1 chassis removes light residue; combined residue is unlikely to be noticeable.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Number of families (butter + film former + two polymers) keeps moderate realistic.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: nonspecific (late butter, film former and polymers do not distinguish repair or moisture). Polyester-37 is a possible shine/volume film route.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met only through prominent Glycerin (5) humectant route; no prominent comfort route (Panthenol 14 is post-fragrance).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.
